rewrite.source: ne React-style memo hook using R/Z render primitives
rewrite.reason: this runtime has no React render loop to host a memo hook
rewrite.replacement: TurnDiffAccumulator keeps the last processed index, turn counter, shrinking-list reset, per-turn settlement and reverse() ordering; it walks only messages added since the previous call

notes: A create result with an empty structured patch synthesizes one hunk from its content lines, each prefixed with +, at oldStart 0/newStart 1.
A message list shorter than the last processed index resets the walk.
The result is newest-first; the same open turn object is reused when it later completes.
The DiffDialog component, file list/detail rendering and key bindings remain out.
